plugins.name: wovenflow
plugins.description: Doc-Test-Driven Development (DTDD) — literate-programming-flavored TDD. Five skills: designflow (Design phase — write .spec.md with user stories + if/when/then behaviors, prose only), testflow (Test phase — insert inline test blocks; bundled extractor produces derived .test.ts at pretest time, runner-agnostic), subflow (Build phase — dispatch implementer subagents per behavior in parallel git worktrees, with spec-compliance and code-quality review; subagents read .spec.md by file path), researchflow (pre-design phase — surfaces 3-5 concrete external references: papers, prior systems, design patterns, library options, RFCs, ecosystem conventions before drafting the spec), and setup (interactive workflow wizard — detects existing CLAUDE.md workflow, walks through each phase suggesting skills or crafting custom ones from bundled scaffold templates including parameterized claim/startup/wrap-up/pre-pr, writes settled workflow back to CLAUDE.md).
